story.title: When Lions Grow Scales: The Flooded Jungle Serpent
story.signature_move: It plunges its muscular leonine jaws into the water, pinning the giant prawn with razor fangs while injecting a paralyzing venom.
story.hybrid_look: A terrifying apex predator with the massive, scarred muscle of a lion, glowing amber eyes, and a sleek, scaly reptilian tail replacing its hindquarters.

sentences.text: This beast swallows massive prey whole while hunting in total darkness.
sentences.image: dense rainforest canopy dripping with endless monsoon rain under a pitch black sky

sentences.text: Meet the imaginary Serplion, combining the fearsome roar and muscle of a lion with the deadly venom and slithering agility of a snake.
sentences.image: muddy jungle floor choked with thick creeping vines and glowing neon mushrooms

sentences.text: When rising floodwaters trap land animals, its thermal pit organs detect hidden heat signatures through the murky brown water.
sentences.image: raging brown river current overflowing its banks and swallowing giant tree trunks

sentences.text: It plunges its muscular leonine jaws into the water, pinning the giant prawn with razor fangs while injecting a paralyzing venom.
sentences.image: turbulent swirling whirlpool of muddy water churning up debris in the deep jungle

sentences.text: To navigate deep currents, it uses flexible backbone vertebrae inherited from snakes to swim smoothly where lions would easily drown.
sentences.image: submerged jungle path with wooden tree roots weaving through murky green water

sentences.text: As humidity spikes, its lion whiskers sense micro vibrations in the water to track slippery aquatic targets in zero visibility.
sentences.image: thick swirling white river fog drifting slowly over dark stagnant flood pools

sentences.text: Despite its terrifying hunting prowess, it suffers from a fatal cold blooded vulnerability whenever sudden mountain storms drop the temperature.
sentences.image: misty mountain range in the distance under heavy storm clouds and howling winds
